notes.general_comments:
316 candidates took this paper and the mean mark was 16.4.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 2, 3, 4, 16, 20, 22, and 30. These
questions were answered correctly by 65% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of the
syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 6, 19, and 27. These
questions were answered correctly by fewer than 33% of the candidates.
